comparisons.baseline_assumption: FortyGuard temperature API is the primary external data source
comparisons.observed_reality: NWS API provides authoritative real-time weather data (forecast, alerts, observations) without API key. FortyGuard API requires credentials not available in environment.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No frozen invariant threatened. Evidence-first architecture preserved — NWS data becomes additional primary evidence source, not a replacement for FortyGuard thermal intelligence.

comparisons.baseline_assumption: FortyGuard satellite segmentation provides vegetation/pavement/built-environment evidence
comparisons.observed_reality: USGS/NLCD provides 30m resolution tree canopy cover (1985-2025), fractional impervious surface, and land cover classification — direct, independently attributable physical-environment evidence. FortyGuard satellite segmentation remains available but is one of multiple sources.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No frozen invariant threatened. Provider-independent evidence contract preserved — government GIS becomes first-class evidence provider alongside FortyGuard.

comparisons.baseline_assumption: No authoritative weather observation source identified
comparisons.observed_reality: NWS API provides free, authoritative real-time data: forecast, alerts, observations, grid data. Phoenix has active Extreme Heat Warning and Air Quality Alert during discovery.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No frozen invariant threatened. NWS becomes primary current-observation source.

comparisons.baseline_assumption: No historical climate data source identified
comparisons.observed_reality: NOAA/NCEI CDO API provides daily/historical temperatures, climatological records, and heat-event data. Requires API key (not exercised).
comparisons.invariant_impact: No frozen invariant threatened. NOAA/NCEI becomes primary historical-climate source.

comparisons.baseline_assumption: Local news provides primary contextual evidence
comparisons.observed_reality: Local news remains contextual evidence. NWS alerts provide authoritative weather event documentation. Municipal resources (Maricopa County heat website) provide official response information.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No invariant threatened. Evidence hierarchy preserved.

comparisons.observed_reality: Quickstart analysis confirms 5 endpoints: heatmap, env_params, satellite_segmentation, street_view_segmentation, heat_intelligence. The /v1/heat-intelligence endpoint generates a PDF report, not a simple data endpoint.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No invariant threatened. API integration details are implementation-level.

comparisons.baseline_assumption: Database schema has 6 tables: temperature_cache, heat_documents, heat_embeddings, evidence_log, sessions, messages
comparisons.observed_reality: Schema is appropriate for initial implementation. Adding GIS/NWS/NOAA data may require additional tables or evidence storage patterns.
comparisons.invariant_impact: No invariant threatened — schema evolution is implementation detail.
